description: HTML file for a web-based database viewer interface, including styles and JavaScript functions to load and display database, table, and data information dynamically.
external_files: JavaScript external resources if any (none explicitly referenced)

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches list of databases and displays them in the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases, resetting current selections.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses database to show tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches tables for selected database and displays them.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Loads and displays data from selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Constructs HTML for table data display.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Renders individual cell content, handling objects and long text with expand/collapse functionality.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content, toggling between full and truncated view.
